organizations.publicNote: Milan music publisher of the Italian versions of “Ninon”, “You’re All I Need” and “San Francisco”.

sources.shortCitation: OPAC SBN, Curci F.1173 C — “Ninon” (Italian, Michele Galdieri), c1933
sources.fullCitation: Ninon: slow-fox dal film “Aspetto una signora”. Versi di M. Galdieri; musica di B. Kaper, W. Jurmann. Milano: Curci, c1933. Plate F.1173 C. [4] pp., voice or mandolin. OPAC SBN record IT\ICCU\LO1\1273644.
sources.title: Ninon — Edizioni Curci, F.1173 C (c1933)
sources.researchNote: The same catalogue records the edition for voice and piano (plate F1172C), printed by Curci in 1934 (CFI0576697) and also issued under the Wiener Boheme-Verlag imprint, c1933 (TSA1543640), which names the film as Cine-Allianz’s “Aspetto una signora”; Cine-Allianz produced Ein Lied für Dich. Sieghardt (op. 088/I) calls the film “Aspetto una signorina”.
sources.creator: Istituto Centrale per il Catalogo Unico (ICCU)

sources.shortCitation: OPAC SBN, Curci E. 1491 C — “Tu sei l’amor” (Italian, Alfredo Bracchi), ©1935
sources.fullCitation: Tu sei l’amor: slow dal film Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Escapade. Versi originali di G. Kahn; versi italiani di A. Bracchi; musica di Jurmann Kaper. Milano: Curci, ©1935 (printed 1936). Plate E. 1491 C. OPAC SBN record IT\ICCU\CFI\0573411.
sources.title: Tu sei l’amor — Edizioni Curci, E. 1491 C (©1935)
sources.researchNote: The edition names Escapade and Gus Kahn’s original words but not the English title; the Columbia disc DQ 1824 (SRC0995) gives the Italian and English titles together.

sources.researchNote: The voice-and-piano edition (plate E. 1578) is recorded as CFI0573483. Columbia issued the Italian version sung by the Orchestra Pieraldo with vocal trio (DDS0255041).

works.title: Ninon
works.publicNote: Italian version by Michele Galdieri, published in Milan by Curci in 1933 as from “Aspetto una signora”, the Italian release of Ein Lied für Dich, and recorded in Italy by Franco Lary, Crivel and others.

works.title: Tu sei l’amor
works.publicNote: Italian version by Alfredo Bracchi, published in Milan by Curci (©1935) as from the MGM film Escapade, with Gus Kahn’s original words acknowledged; an Italian Columbia disc gives it as “Tu sei l’amore = You’re all I need”.

works.title: San Francisco
works.publicNote: Italian version by Michele Galdieri, published in Milan by Curci (©1937) with Gus Kahn’s American words acknowledged, as from the MGM film San Francisco.
